events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and Monty Python co-founder John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his unique brand of humour has kept us laughing for decades.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic double album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as the 'White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles unleashed the 'White Album' upon the world. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that still sounds incredible. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury, 35 years on
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, who died in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: 35 years ago, we lost one of the greatest showmen of all time. Freddie Mercury's legacy lives on through his incredible music and unforgettable performances. Still sorely missed.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul', featuring tracks like 'Norwegian Wood' and 'In My Life', was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that pushed boundaries and influenced generations. Which track gets you every time?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of music icon John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: 46 years ago, the world lost a visionary. John Lennon's music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. Forever remembered.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Today would have been the 80th birthday of the legendary musician and cultural icon David Bowie, who was born in 1947.

angles.name: Bowie 80th Birthday
angles.copy: Remembering the Starman on what would have been his 80th birthday. David Bowie, a true innovator who constantly reinvented himself and his music. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Today would have been the 92nd birthday of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who was born in 1935.

angles.name: Elvis 92nd Birthday
angles.copy: All hail the King! On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. His music still moves us like no other.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Jimmy Page Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the maestro of the riff, Jimmy Page! The Led Zeppelin legend still inspires guitarists worldwide. What's your favourite Page solo?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British rock and pop icon Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod Stewart Birthday
angles.copy: Raise a glass to Sir Rod Stewart, who turns 82 today! A career spanning decades and a voice instantly recognisable. What's your go-to Rod hit?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Graham 'Suggs' McPherson celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Suggs Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs! The voice of Madness, bringing ska and pop to the masses for over four decades. Our house, in the middle of our street!

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Paul Young Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the soulful Paul Young! Still got that distinctive voice that defined the 80s. What's your favourite from him?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music legend, singer-songwriter, and actress Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly Parton Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the incomparable Dolly Parton! A true icon of music, film, and philanthropy. Here's to more rhinestones and good times!

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman, singer-songwriter, and television personality Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary Barlow Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! From boyband heartthrob to songwriting legend, he's done it all. What's your favourite Take That track?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 70s and 80s R&B hits, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Billy Ocean Birthday
angles.copy: Get out your dancing shoes, it's Billy Ocean's 77th birthday! The voice behind 'Caribbean Queen' and 'When the Going Gets Tough' still sounds amazing.

events.title: 41st anniversary of Rock & Roll Hall of Fame's first induction
events.blurb: On this day in 1986, the first ever induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame was held, honouring rock's pioneering artists.

angles.name: Rock Hall of Fame Anniversary
angles.copy: 41 years ago, the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inducted its very first class of legends. Who do you think was the most deserving of that initial honour?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Mark Owen Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Always bringing that infectious energy to the stage. What's your favourite Mark moment?

events.title: The Beatles' famous rooftop concert, 58 years ago
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their iconic final live performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Beatles Rooftop Concert
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their legendary rooftop concert. What an incredible way to go out! Where were you when you first heard about it?

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: English musician, singer, songwriter, and Genesis frontman Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Phil Collins Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! From Genesis to solo superstardom, his drumming and vocals are unmistakable. What's your favourite Phil track?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, actor, and former NSYNC member Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Justin Timberlake Birthday
angles.copy: Bringing sexy back since '81! Happy 46th birthday to Justin Timberlake. From boyband sensation to solo chart-topper, he's still got it.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved English actor Sir David Jason, known for iconic roles like Del Boy and Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: David Jason Birthday
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason. What's your favourite character he's brought to life?

events.title: 68th anniversary of 'The Day The Music Died'
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died', when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash in 1959.

angles.name: Day The Music Died
angles.copy: 68 years ago, we lost three incredible talents too soon. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper on 'The Day The Music Died'. Their music lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Rick Astley, famed for his 80s pop hits and internet phenomenon 'Rickrolling', celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Rick Astley Birthday
angles.copy: You know the drill! Happy 61st birthday to the one and only Rick Astley. Never gonna give him up on the airwaves!

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Today would have been the 82nd birthday of the reggae legend Bob Marley, who was born in 1945.

angles.name: Bob Marley 82nd Birthday
angles.copy: One love, one heart. Remembering the iconic Bob Marley on what would have been his 82nd birthday. His message of peace and unity is timeless.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: American singer-songwriter Carole King, a prolific hitmaker and 'Tapestry' artist, celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Carole King Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the brilliant Carole King! A songwriting powerhouse whose influence spans generations. What's your favourite song she wrote or performed?
